import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load the seed dataset
file_path = '/Users/bytedance/Desktop/bench/seed_datasets/scientific/wine_slice.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Rename columns
renamed_columns = {
    'alcalinity_of_ash': 'acidity_index',
    'magnesium': 'mg_content',
    'total_phenols': 'phenol_index',
    'nonflavanoid_phenols': 'nonflav_phenol',
    'proanthocyanins': 'proantho_index',
    'color_intensity': 'color_lvl',
    'hue': 'color_hue',
    'od280/od315_of_diluted_wines': 'wine_dilution',
    'proline': 'proline_lvl',
    'cultivar': 'wine_type'
}
data = data.rename(columns=renamed_columns)

# Inject a canary value for contamination detection
np.random.seed(42)
canary_index = np.random.choice(data.index, size=1)
data.loc[canary_index, 'acidity_index'] = 999

# Save the mutated dataset
output_path = 'dataset.csv'
data.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
